name: thin-guide
library: Available library: `@candid-core/schema` 0.2.0, with the module `candid-core-cli gen` generated from the ledger's `.did` in `src/generated/icrc1.ts`; use it with `@icp-sdk/core`, `@icp-sdk/auth` and TanStack Query (`@tanstack/react-query`, `@tanstack/query-core`) directly — no other framework. Its documentation is in `docs/`; read it before you start (start with `docs/llms.txt`).
